items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The bass player, Curley Russell, looked up at us, J. J. and I, and just shook his head

ctx.x: Yeah, playing my drums. I said, I bet I won’t be playing with this band long. The bass player, Curley Russell, looked up at us, J. J. and I, and just shook his head, because the tempo’s like this and we’re in . . .
